title: Rosetta App Meta
description: Per-app metadata: identity, platform detection, agent orientation. One file per app at registry/apps/{app_id}/meta.json.

schema_version.description: Locked at 1 for v0. Major-version bumps signal breaking changes.

id.description: Stable kebab-case identifier. Must match the folder name under registry/apps/.

category.description: Optional descriptive grouping (e.g. "code-editor", "image-editor"). Informational; not used for ranking.

detection.description: Per-platform hints that os.app_info uses to detect installed version + identity. At least one platform key required.

search_first_supported.description: True when the app exposes a command palette / fuzzy action search. Drives the search_first_if_supported dispatch step.

command_palette_shortcut.description: Per-platform key combo to open the command palette. Required if search_first_supported is true and palette differs from a single-key default.

vendor_friendly.description: Parking-lot item 9: vendor stance toward automation. Hostile vendors (anti-bot, captcha walls) tend to score low on reliability.

locale.description: Parking-lot item 10: locale that meta + shortcuts target. v0 assumes "en".

agent_primer.description: Markdown-friendly free-text orientation for agents: app terminology, element layout, canonical interaction patterns. Rendered verbatim into apps/{app_id}/skill.md by the backend.
